title: Regions and Provenance
description: Per-region ingest rate, queue depth, and provenance-disagreement monitoring. The 'Provenance disagreements' table shows points where a device's claimed region tag disagrees with region_src (the vhost it was actually consumed from). An empty table indicates successful multi-region segregation.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "seq")
  |> group(columns: ["region_src"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "rabbitmq_queue")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "messages_ready")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.queue == "telemetry.eu.q" or r.queue == "telemetry.us.q")
  |> group(columns: ["queue"])

from(bucket: "telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r._field == "seq")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.region != r.region_src)
  |> group(columns: ["region", "region_src"])
  |> count()
